title: Stalks of sheaf Ext for coherent modules
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. For every point $x\in X$ and every integer $q\geq0$ the stalk at $x$ of the sheaf Ext [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-ext] satisfies $\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)_x\cong\operatorname{Ext}^q_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal F_x,\mathcal G_x)$, the right-hand side the Ext [def-pc-ext] in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules.

source.place: Lemma lemma-Ext-0-regular (Tag 0FZ3), proof of (1), using Cohomology Lemma Tag 0GM8 and Derived Categories Lemma Tag 0GM8 with 08E8 and 0A64 (corrected by L from 08DJ, reviewer R-es2)

proof.text: Apply the coherent-sheaf stalk localization theorem to X, F, G, x and i=q. Its hypotheses hold because the item assumes X Noetherian and F coherent; it gives the canonical isomorphism H^q(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(F[0],G[0]))_x \cong H^q(R\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(F_x[0],G_x[0])).

proof.text: By the sheaf Ext definition, the left side of this isomorphism is \mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(F,G)_x.

proof.text: Apply the ring derived-Hom cohomology comparison with R=\mathcal O_{X,x}, M=F_x, N=G_x and n=q. It identifies the right side with \operatorname{Ext}^q_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(F_x,G_x); substituting the identifications from the previous steps proves the claim.
